mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, which reduces discount rates for equity valuations and drives positive forward returns in the S&P 500 over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during periods of declining FEDFUNDS (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 9.5% over a 3-month window signals weakening labor market conditions, which increases the likelihood of central bank intervention and triggers a flight to equity risk premia, producing positive forward returns in the S&P 500 over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when UNRATE exceeds 9.5% (t-test p > 0.05) or the signal fails to outperform a random baseline in 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both housing starts and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based weakening in aggregate demand, which triggers a policy response and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as markets anticipate fiscal or monetary stimulus.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 60-day SPX returns in more than 50% of instances, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) in a multivariate regression.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in industrial production below 100.0 (index 2017=100) signals a contraction in real economic output, which increases the probability of a recession and triggers a flight to quality, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO falls below 100.0 (t-test p > 0.05) or the signal generates positive returns in more than 55% of triggered cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the CPIAUCSL above 217.5 over a 2-month window signals accelerating inflation, which increases the probability of aggressive monetary tightening and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to rising discount rates.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative when CPIAUCSL exceeds 217.5 (t-test p > 0.05) or the signal fails to achieve a Rank IC > 0.05 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in both housing starts and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals a strong rebound in aggregate demand, which boosts corporate earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint rise in HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 60-day SPX returns in more than 55% of instances, or the interaction term is not significant (p > 0.05) in a regression model.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in non-farm payroll growth below 100,000 over a 3-month window signals labor market stagnation, which increases the likelihood of central bank intervention and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as equity valuations reprice on lower discount rates.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when PAYEMS growth falls below 100k (t-test p > 0.05) or the signal generates negative returns in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP (GDPC1) over the past 5 months, combined with a rising unemployment rate, indicates a late-cycle economic slowdown, which triggers a policy pivot and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as markets anticipate stimulus.
failure_condition: The joint decline in GDPC1 and rise in UNRATE fails to produce positive 60-day SPX returns in more than 55% of instances, or the interaction effect is not significant (p > 0.05) in a multivariate model.
